sloka: पुरा भ्रात: पिता न: स मातरं ते समुद्वहन् ।मातामहे समाश्रौषीद्राज्यशुल्कमनुत्तमम् ॥ २.१०७.३॥
transliteration: purā bhrāta: pitā na: sa mātaraṁ te samudvahan ।mātāmahe samāśrauṣīdrājyaśulkamanuttamam ॥ 2.107.3॥

translations.english: Earlier when our father was to wed your mother, O dear brother, he had promised to your maternal grandfather that he would confer (on her) a kingdom with good revenue.
